question: What paradoxical condition affects even the wise at the tip of nectar?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
There is burning by the essence of juice
inference: Even a wise person experiences burning at the tip of nectar by the essence of the fluid.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is doctrinally specific.
plain_english: Even the wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the fluid.
